forbidden_semantic_inputs: commit messages/diffs/file snippets or unrelated metadata exposed only while resolving repository head
policy.feedback_use: mechanical self-local QC only; never infer novelty/relevance/acceptance/ranking/preferred mechanism
policy.own_state_resolution: LATEST/STATE first; otherwise newest source-qualified role-local checkpoint by repository chronology; minimum predecessor chain; quarantine accidental stale/cross-role observability reads
policy.scope_guard: never broaden evidence beyond tested scope
policy.continuation: open-ended; checkpoints/findings are never global completion; maintain nonempty frontier and exact next action until hard runtime/tool termination
policy.receipt_rule: write immutable own receipt only; never read aggregate ledger or other receipts
policy.control_freshness: obtain note main SHA only via Git ref-object lookup such as refs/heads/main or equivalent SHA-only response; never use generic commit/search/branch payloads for head freshness. Read sanitized DESIRED_STATE and this role config at that SHA; repeat SHA-only ref lookup before substantive work and refetch on changed control/config revision; freeze selected config after semantic start; quarantine/discard excess connector semantic payload.
policy.connector_discovery_read_only: Discover connector/tool/schema capability only through non-mutating schema/list/discovery and read-only lookup. Never create, update, delete, move, or otherwise mutate a branch, ref, file, pull request, issue, release, workflow, external resource, or account state as a noop/test/probe. A connector mutation is allowed only when required by substantive open_source work and confined to the authorized open_source role-local state/output or immutable own receipt destinations with CAS/readback.
policy.repository_write_boundary: Authorized writes are confined to research_workers_clean_g1/open_source/ role-local state/output pointers and automation_control/receipts/open_source/ immutable receipts. Temporary/noop branches or refs, probe PRs/issues/releases/workflows, and mutations outside those destinations are forbidden.

migration.reason: A config5 invocation under root control12 self-blocked before semantic work because open_source is incident-bearing and lacked the explicit role-local read-only connector-discovery/write-boundary guard that root12 requires for such roles. Config6 makes the guard local and executable without changing research semantics.
migration.rollback_condition: Only if the guard blocks an explicitly authorized open_source role-local substantive write or prevents safe checkpointing; do not relax CLEAN semantic isolation or permit connector probe mutations.
